Kanban BP-TUNE-93939: 'rosie and petalia TURNIPS SHOULD NOT BE UP B THEY SHOULD BE DOWN B AND ALSO AVAILABLE IN THE AIR'. Rosie's own Insert Coin moved entirely off her old neutral-B slot (hold W) onto a real down-B (hold S) -- her hold-W input now does nothing where Insert Coin used to fire. Petalia gets a real, dedicated down-B for the first time -- previously only reachable via the generic neutral-B fallback (hold W, grounded only); now spawn_turnip is wired to her own real down-B, explicitly excluded from the generic fallback matching every other tuned character's own pattern. Both now real, genuinely usable in the air, via a new branch checked before the existing airborne umbrella-toggle fallback (which would otherwise silently swallow every airborne down-B press). New test_rosie_petalia_turnip_is_down_b_not_up_b confirms all 4 real cases (Rosie hold-up=nothing, Rosie hold-down=Insert Coin, Petalia hold-down grounded=turnip, Petalia hold-down airborne=turnip). bash scripts/build.sh clean, all 8 physics tests pass. README updated. BRAWLPIT commit 3a07b68. session: sess-20260902-2008-ed50169e

⚓ ☃
title: BP-TUNE-93939: Rosie/Petalia turnip toss remapped to real down-B, air-available
